Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [제어] Stun a Restless Amani with its Gravebound Advance shield still up using Storm Bolt or Shockwave to delay it reaching the Soulcoil Well.
[생존기] When soaking Hungering Pyre in the intermission, reduce all damage by 30% with Die by the Sword or reduce the magic damage with Spell Reflection.
@m [차단] If you are on the well-kill team, interrupt Drowned Echo's Soulcoiler's Curse with Pummel.

Entombed Sentinels: [우선 처치] When a Venom Coagulation ooze spawns, dump Colossus Smash and Avatar to kill it right away.
[참고] The boss takes 99% less damage during Vitriolic Stasis, so hold Avatar and Colossus Smash until after the intermission.
[생존기] When soaking Unstable Miasma, reduce the Shadow magic damage with Spell Reflection.

Vashnik the Malignant: [우선 처치] AoE down the venom adds with Bladestorm or Cleave before they reach the center.
[제어] Burning Venom can be held with Storm Bolt or Shockwave until Hardened Venom.
@m [생존기] Put Rallying Cry into the raid defensive rotation for Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion.

The Lost Explorers: [차단] Interrupt Scrollsage Iku's Icebound Flames with Pummel.
[우선 처치] Hit the two stacked bosses together with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave so the damage also hits First Mate Nama.
[생존기] Blink Nova and Fishy Feedback are magic damage, so reduce them with Spell Reflection.

Sszorak: [생존기] Sszorak takes more damage during the 25 sec Dig In, so line up Avatar and Colossus Smash with it.
[분담] When soaking Mutilate, reduce the Nature magic damage with Spell Reflection.
@m [위치] If To the Slaughter hits you and you get Virulence, spread out immediately with Heroic Leap.

The Twin Fangs: [우선 처치] Apply Colossus Smash to the Venomous Emergence adds and kill them first.
[생존기] When soaking Ravenous Feast, reduce the physical damage with Die by the Sword.
@m [차단] Interrupt Broodling of Ithraz's Visceral Burst and Caustic Globule's Barbed Bulwark with Pummel.

The Coiled Altar: [우선 처치] Ghastly Regeneration in the intermission makes Zul'jan take 100% more damage, so dump Avatar and Colossus Smash.
[차단] Once the Veil of Twilight shield breaks, interrupt Eternal Nightfall with Pummel.
@hm [해제] If a missed Wail of Terror interrupt gets you feared, break it with Berserker Rage.

Ula'tek: [우선 처치] Dump Avatar and Colossus Smash into the Venomous Heart exposed after Rage of the Shackled.
[차단] Interrupt Malice, Anguished Cry, and Vicious Echoes with Pummel.
[생존기] Put Rallying Cry into the raid defensive rotation for the 20 sec of Rage of the Shackled raid damage.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [우선 처치] Kill the Bubblefin Shorerunners drawn in by Alluring Bubble with Bladestorm before they reach the bubble.
[생존기] Pop! and Unending Tides are Frost magic damage, so reduce them with Spell Reflection and line up Rallying Cry with Unending Tides.
@m [우선 처치] Waterfog Shield reduces damage to nearby murlocs by 99%, so kill the Bubblefin Frostscale before using Bladestorm.

Imperator Averzian: [차단] In the intermission, interrupt Pitch Bulwark from Shadowguard Stalwart and Voidbound Annihilator with Pummel.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Voidmaw packs with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave.
[생존기] If assigned to Dark Upheaval at the pull and after each intermission, raise the raid's max health with Rallying Cry.

Vorasius: [우선 처치] Kill the Blistercreeps gathered at the wall together with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave so Blisterburst breaks the Void Crystal.
[회피] During Void Breath, Heroic Leap across to the far end of the room opposite the glowing hand.
@m [생존기] When the first Blistercreep pack pops, reduce damage taken with Die by the Sword.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [우선 처치] When Concentrated Void orbs spawn, close in right away with Charge and kill them before they reach the boss.
[차단] Interrupt Shadow Fracture from the nearest Fractured Image with Pummel or Storm Bolt.
[생존기] The boss takes 25% more damage during the 20 sec Entropic Unraveling, so line up Avatar and Colossus Smash, and hold through the raid damage with Die by the Sword.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] If Dread Breath fears you, break it yourself with Berserker Rage.
[차단] Interrupt Voidorb's Voidbolt with Pummel, and if several are grouped, stun them together with Shockwave.
[분담] When taking Gloomtouched in the Gloom path, reduce the magic damage taken with Spell Reflection.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [차단] After breaking War Chaplain Senn's Sacred Shield, interrupt Blinding Light with Pummel.
[우선 처치] Right after the pull, line up Avatar and Colossus Smash on Commander Venel Lightblood, who takes more damage from Avenging Wrath.
[분담] When soaking Execution Sentence next to the target, reduce damage taken with Die by the Sword.

Crown of the Cosmos: [우선 처치] Kill the Void Droplets under the sentinel by hitting them together with Sweeping Strikes and Cleave.
[회피] When Vorelus's Ravenous Abyss comes, get 15 yards out with Heroic Leap.
@nh [차단] Interrupt Undying Voidspawn's Void Barrage with Pummel, and stun grouped packs with Shockwave.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [차단] Interrupt Haunting Essence's Fearsome Cry first with Pummel.
[해제] If a missed interrupt gets you feared by Fearsome Cry, break it yourself with Berserker Rage.
[우선 처치] If you are on the lower floor team, save Avatar and Bladestorm to break the adds' Alnshroud shields quickly.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [차단] If your feather color matches, interrupt the embers' Light Eruption or Void Eruption with Pummel.
[분담] When soaking Light Dive or Void Dive with same-color players, reduce damage taken with Die by the Sword.
[생존기] During the Phase 2 egg's Rebirth, dump Avatar and Colossus Smash to burn down Immortal Flame.

Midnight Falls: @nh [차단] Interrupt the Safeguard Matrix's Safeguard casts with Pummel and Storm Bolt to remove all stacks.
@m [차단] Interrupt Terminate from your assigned Termination Matrix in order with Pummel.
[생존기] During the 25 sec of Shattered Sky Shadow damage, reduce damage taken with Die by the Sword.

Rotmire: @hm [차단] Always interrupt Sporecap's Poison Burst with Pummel.
[우선 처치] AoE down the Shroomlings and Bursting Shrooms gathered at the set spot with Bladestorm and Ravager.
[위치] The Festering Vines target is slowed, so Heroic Leap to the edge of the room.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: Spell Reflection은 툴팁상 마법 피해 20% 감소만 근거로 썼고 보스 주문 반사는 쓰지 않았다
Demolish는 거신 영웅 특성 전용이라 넣지 않았다
1시즌: Spell Reflection은 툴팁의 마법 피해 20% 감소만 근거로 암흑 피해인 Gloomtouched에 썼고 보스 주문 반사는 쓰지 않았다
1시즌: Berserker Rage는 툴팁 'removing Fear' 기준으로 공포인 Dread Breath·Fearsome Cry에만 썼다. 학살자·거신 영웅 특성 전용 기술(Demolish 등)은 넣지 않았다
